verdict.rationale: Plausible documents two public HTTP APIs. The Stats API is a read-only query interface: a POST /api/v2/query endpoint, JSON responses and team-scoped API keys. The Events API records pageviews and custom events. However, the Stats API is explicitly read-only, and the pack shows no API for managing sites, goals or settings, so an agent can query and ingest data but cannot fully drive the product. Missing for 10: a documented management/configuration API (sites, goals, funnels), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Plausible Stats API is a read-only HTTP interface for viewing historical and real-time stats.
The /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex stats queries in the POST request body and returns the metrics as JSON.
API keys are scoped to one team.
The Plausible Events API can be used to record pageviews and custom events.
